baseline: Existing AdaptiveBrain, OnlineReadout and ForecastCouncil implementations; identical 72-dimensional input/readout and learning rules in every branch. This is the perception/forecast path, not a full-organism or market evaluation.

worlds.delayed_dependency: First four sides are random; subsequent side copies the side four events earlier with 0.90 probability. Quote amount is independently chosen from 0.25 and 2.0 SOL-equivalent synthetic units; fee is 0.005 times quote. No actual coin or transaction is represented.
worlds.context_reversal: Repeat the previous side with probability 0.9 for small quotes and 0.1 for large quotes; the mapping reverses halfway through. The generating amount precedes its next-side label, which is not revealed until the next observation.

scoring: Score each stored next-side probability when the next side arrives, before any training on it. Include observations indexed 64 through 159, 96 scored outcomes per task/seed/branch.
primary: Paired mean council Brier reduction current minus coupled; lower loss is better.
secondary: Proportion of differing neural hashes and action-score vectors
Per-window wall time, cold setup cost and peak RSS

inference.interval: two-sided 95% Student t interval across six paired environment seeds, critical=2.5705818366147395; no independent neural-initialization replication
inference.promotion_gate: Every task must have mean council Brier reduction >=0.005 and a positive lower 95% bound; zero-return branch must reproduce current neural hashes; causal direction and exact checkpoint continuation tests must pass. Both tasks must pass, so the gate is an intersection claim. All other contrasts are descriptive.

coupling: TVB Wilson-Cowan, deterministic Heun dt=1 ms, 4 m/s conduction and gain 0.1; warm up 1000 ms. Exchange previous-window regional activity and Brian population rates with a 20 ms delay in both directions. Six declared engineering ports; no inferred anatomical functional equivalence.

dataset.provenance: TVB demonstration connectivity, documented as hybrid CoCoMac/DSI. It must not be described as a purely human or owner-specific connectome.

shuffle: Relocate nonzero weight/tract-length pairs without self edges using a fixed seed. Preserve density and the joint nonzero weight/length distribution, then normalize by maximum row sum. Degree and strength sequences are not preserved; this is a limited topology null.
limits: Synthetic task families, small sample and one fixed Brian neural initialization
No live production checkpoints or wallet credentials
No real token activity, biological neurons, paid jobs or consciousness inference
No use of task names, hidden regime, future sides or unchosen counterfactual outcomes by the learner
No parameter search or result-driven task selection; failures and non-positive results must be published
The running production worker is not replaced on the basis of mechanism complexity alone
